heading: Other functions and activities
lead: For the purpose of more effectively coordinating the policies and functions of the United States Government relating to homeland security, the Council shall—

tree.text: assess the objectives, commitments, and risks of the United States in the interest of homeland security and to 1 make resulting recommendations to the President;
oversee and review homeland security policies of the Federal Government and to 1 make resulting recommendations to the President; and
perform such other functions as the President may direct.
